commands.cmd:
MIX_ENV=test mix run --no-start shacl_probe.exs 'friday48c5e3f=<xaas 48c5e3f:docs/sjira/v26.9.22/friday/goal.ttl>' 'v23c18ecd3+friday=<xaas c18ecd3:docs/sjira/v26.9.23/goal.ttl>,<friday goal.ttl>'  -- shacl_probe.exs (sha256 37007538bb099b193a05244346a3783734824f79c94ab8ebb34ddc971b253eae) verbatim: # Read-only SHACL admission probe: pack ontology.ttl (subject bytes) merged with xaas goal graphs,
# validated by GgenIgniter.SemanticJira.Shacl against the pack shapes. argv: <label>=<ttl>[,<ttl>...] ...
alias GgenIgniter.Ontology
alias GgenIgniter.SemanticJira.Shacl
sj = "https://ggen-igniter.dev/ontology/semantic-jira#"
excl = RDF.iri(sj <> "exclusion")
drop = fn g, p -> g |> RDF.Graph.triples() |> Enum.reject(fn {_, q, _} -> q == p end) |> RDF.Graph.new() end
pack = Ontology.load!("priv/ggen/semantic-jira-pack/ontology.ttl")
for arg <- System.argv() do
  [label, files] = String.split(arg, "=", parts: 2)
  graph = files |> String.split(",") |> Enum.reduce(pack, &RDF.Graph.add(&2, Ontology.load!(&1)))
  variants = [{"full", graph}, {"no-exclusion", drop.(graph, excl)}] ++
    for(f <- ~w(requiresCapability successorPolicy), do: {"no-" <> f <> "(anti-vacuity)", drop.(graph, RDF.iri(sj <> f))})
  for {tag, g} <- variants do
    r = Shacl.validate_file(g)
    n_excl = g |> RDF.Graph.triples() |> Enum.count(fn {_, p, _} -> p == excl end)
    IO.puts("#{label} #{tag}: triples=#{RDF.Graph.triple_count(g)} sj:exclusion=#{n_excl} conforms=#{r.conforms} violations=#{length(r.violations)} focus_nodes=#{r.focus_node_count} shapes=#{length(r.shapes_checked)}")
    Enum.each(Enum.take(r.violations, 2), &IO.inspect(&1, label: "  violation"))
  end
end
